sources.ref: Walkplay Android app 2.3.1 (com.ttgk.musicbox): its product catalog (data/catalogs/walkplay.json) lists 0x3302:0x4312 "Oshun DECO" under scheme 16; band count, filter types and Q and pre-gain limits as the app's editor gives them for that scheme

meta.notes:
Guided read with the eqcaps inspector on 2026-10-04: the values were set in https://peq.szwalkplay.com/ and read back from the device. The EQ at the end differs from the EQ at the start. Bands 2–10 not checked: assumed to match band 1. Pre-gain not checked: its read-back held 0.
Against devicePEQ's shape, Walkplay's Android app (2.3.1) lists this device under scheme 16: the same 10 bands, with the low pass and high pass filters that the 2026-10-04 read found beside peaking and the shelves. The read-back held Q 9.8984375 on band 1, which fits walkplay-app's Q limit of 10 (Walkplay's web app, read from a scheme 11 device) and not the Android app's editor limit of 5. The gain, frequency, Q and pre-gain limits were not read on this device (those experiments were skipped): they are walkplay-app's, not checked on the device.
